title: Remote state snapshot localization holds StateInner across the whole apply (remote_routes.rs:1717)
outcome: Remote state snapshot localization holds StateInner across the whole apply (remote_routes.rs:1717)
acceptance: Applying a remote state snapshot no longer holds StateInner across localizing the whole remote StateResponse; the localization runs outside the lock and the locked section only validates authority and commits, with a measured bound on the hold.
A focused regression shows that an apply of a live-sized remote snapshot does not block an unrelated locked operation for the duration of the localization.
